tools.name: cleardose_search_drug_index
tools.title: Search the Universal Drug Index
tools.description: Search ClearDose's local fictional Universal Drug Index by generic name, brand, category, drug class, or UDI id. Use this when the user needs candidate records or exact drug ids for another tool.

query.description: Raw search text such as lisinopril, Lipitor, Statin, or udi:cleardose:lisinopril.

category.description: Optional exact category returned by a prior search.

drugClass.description: Optional exact drug class returned by a prior search.

tools.name: cleardose_get_drug_index_entry
tools.title: Get one Universal Drug Index entry
tools.description: Return normalized identity, class, package variants, and fictional price offers for one exact ClearDose UDI drug id. Use after search_drug_index identifies the record.

drugId.description: Exact ClearDose UDI drug id such as med_lisinopril.

tools.name: cleardose_compare_drug_prices
tools.title: Compare fictional drug price offers
tools.description: Compare package and delivered-price offers for one to four exact UDI drug ids. Use for price facts only; different drugs are not treated as therapeutic substitutes.

drugIds.description: One to four exact ids returned by search_drug_index.

strength.description: Optional exact strength, such as 10mg. If unavailable, the tool returns the closest indexed package and names it explicitly.

quantity.description: Optional package quantity. If unavailable, the tool returns the closest indexed package and names it explicitly.

tools.name: cleardose_find_related_drugs
tools.title: Find related drug index entries
tools.description: Find other UDI entries in the same broad demo comparison group as one exact drug id. Use the discussion-only matches to prepare questions for a clinician; every result explicitly states that it is not a therapeutic-equivalence or substitution recommendation.

drugId.description: Exact ClearDose UDI drug id returned by search_drug_index.

tools.name: cleardose_review_demo_interaction_flags
tools.title: Review synthetic medication interaction flags
tools.description: Review two to ten exact UDI drug ids against ClearDose's intentionally incomplete synthetic interaction fixtures. Every result exposes coverage gaps and requires verification by a licensed pharmacist.

drugIds.description: Two to ten exact ClearDose UDI ids representing the medication list to review.

tools.name: cleardose_build_procurement_plan
tools.title: Build a local fictional procurement plan
tools.description: Build a local-only plan for one to twelve requested UDI medications using fictional package offers. The result is planning-only and leaves prescription validation, inventory reservation, and ordering to human-controlled workflows.

items.description: Requested UDI records and optional exact package preferences.

drugId.description: Exact UDI drug id returned by search_drug_index.

strategy.description: How to select fictional offers: lowest delivered total, fewest channels, or a simple cost-and-speed balance.

tools.name: cleardose_inspect_workflow_runtime
tools.title: Inspect local workflow runtime
tools.description: Read recent ClearDose workflow instances, transitions, bounded context snapshots, generated cards, and the local DuckDB-Wasm status. Use this to explain what the site and agent have completed without changing state.

flowId.description: Optional exact flow id. Omit it to inspect concurrent recent flows.

tools.name: cleardose_prepare_doctor_question_card_request
tools.title: Prepare a doctor question card handoff
tools.description: Resolve one UDI record, up to three related discussion-only records, and optional patient concerns into a bounded site-to-agent handoff. The result contains an instruction and exact response schema for a second tool call; it does not create clinical guidance.

drugId.description: Exact primary ClearDose UDI drug id.

relatedDrugIds.description: Zero to three discussion-only ids returned by find_related_drugs. Omit to use up to two indexed suggestions.

concerns.description: Zero to six short patient concerns to transform into neutral questions, not instructions or diagnoses.

tools.name: cleardose_submit_doctor_question_card_draft
tools.title: Submit a doctor question card draft
tools.description: Submit the structured response for an existing ClearDose question-card exchange. This stores a local draft for human review and derives all displayed fictional price facts from the UDI rather than agent text.

exchangeId.description: Exact exchange id returned by prepare_doctor_question_card_request.

title.description: Short neutral title for the patient-owned card.

questions.description: Two to eight neutral questions the patient may choose to ask a licensed clinician. Each item must end with a question mark.

tools.name: cleardose_highlight_section
tools.title: Highlight a visible ClearDose section
tools.description: Move keyboard focus to and visibly highlight one stable section on the current ClearDose page so the user and agent can discuss the same content.

target.description: Stable section identifier. If the section is not on the current page, the tool returns a clear non-retryable error.

tools.name: cleardose_get_cart
tools.title: Read the local ClearDose cart
tools.description: Read the current fictional ClearDose cart with item-level and total prices. This tool does not change state or expose customer profile data.

tools.name: cleardose_add_to_cart
tools.title: Add one indexed package to the local cart
tools.description: Add one exact fictional UDI medication package to the local ClearDose cart. Use get_drug_index_entry first to obtain the exact drugId and variantId. This changes only resettable browser demo state.

drugId.description: Exact UDI drug id returned by get_drug_index_entry.

variantId.description: Exact package variant id returned by get_drug_index_entry.
